mapSource: Geofabrik Georgia country extract, with OpenStreetMap France mirror as build-time fallback
notes: The binary map is generated by GitHub Actions from a verified Georgia-country OpenStreetMap PBF. Geofabrik is primary; the OpenStreetMap France mirror is used only when Geofabrik is unreachable. The map is checked against the provider MD5, written with Mapsforge Map Writer type=hd, then packaged inside the APK. The source ZIP does not contain the generated binary. Name variants are included only where available in OSM; no automatic translation is performed. The app currently displays one preferred language at a time. Map Writer receives explicit bbox=41.00,39.95,43.65,46.80 because the CI PBF mirror did not expose a usable bbox in its header; the box is based on Geostat Yearbook 2024 extreme points with a small safety margin. POI SQLite is generated from the exact same verified PBF during map build and is embedded in the APK. Search supports the three stored name fields where OSM provides them; nodes and closed ways are included, relation-only POIs are not yet included. POI search also indexes public address, phone, website, opening_hours, cuisine, wheelchair, internet_access, operator and brand tags when present; these are source values and are not treated as real-time opening or availability status.
languageCoverage: Only OSM name variants present in source data are written; no automatic translation.
mapBuildPipeline: GitHub Actions: cached verified country OSM PBF -> Mapsforge Map Writer -> APK assets

poiDatabase.search: Local substring search across default, English, Russian and Georgian names when present, categories, subcategories, addresses and selected public contact/business tags; no network required.
poiDatabase.geometryCoverage: OSM nodes and closed ways; relation-only POIs are not yet included.
poiDatabase.nameCoverage: Only name variants present in OSM are stored; missing variants are not automatically translated.
poiDatabase.source: Same verified country OSM PBF as the Mapsforge map.
